flags.why: Chín describes ripe fruit, not flowers in full bloom ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ch%C3%ADn)).
Bí ẩn means mysterious or enigmatic, whereas secret in the sense of deliberately concealed is bí mật ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%AD_%E1%BA%A9n)).
The common meaning of removing something worn, such as glasses, a ring or a bandage, is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-th%C3%A1o)).
flags.fix:
verb | to take off; to remove (something worn)
ex: Anh ấy tháo kính ra. = He took off his glasses.

flags.why: The everyday meaning of faded or having lost its original colour is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BA%A1c)).
flags.fix:
adj | faded; having lost its original colour
ex: Áo này đã bạc màu rồi. = This shirt has faded.

flags.why: Tư in numerals such as hai mươi tư is used across regions, so Northern is misleading ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/t%C6%B0)).
Tư meaning private occurs in ordinary speech about personal matters and private ownership and is not restricted to formal language ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/t%C6%B0)).
